remarks: Exceptionally Spacious Condo within Steps of Downtown Stamford! Centrally located corner-unit in the sought-after high-rise building of Hayes House Condominiums, this 2BR/2BA residence immediately captivates with overflowing modern touches. Beautifully filled with brilliant natural light, the immaculate interior features an entry closet, gorgeous wood floors, crown molding, attractive paint hues, openly flowing layout, and an expansive living room with sliding glass doors to the private balcony. Thoughtfully designed for an excellent use of space, the dazzling gourmet kitchen includes stainless-steel appliances, granite countertops, wood cabinets, tile backsplash, and an adjoining dining area with a sparkling chandelier. Ideal for those seeking both form and function, the primary bedroom impresses with ample closet space and an attached en suite boasting a step-in shower and a chic storage vanity. One additional bedroom may be easily utilized for guests, home office, or lifestyle-specific flex space. Guests will enjoy the convenience of the full hallway bathroom, which has a shower/tub combo and a storage vanity. Additional considerations: garage parking with guest area, common laundry area, HOA includes heat, cooling, and hot water, private storage, 24-hour security, on-site superintendent, concierge, bike storage, community gym, courtyard with grills, private storage locker, near Metro North to NYC, I-95, parks, shopping, beach, and public transit, and so much more!
